annotations.title: Ask an agent to follow up

description: Asks a licensed Libertas agent to follow up with the customer: for insurance Libertas doesn't quote in chat (renters, condo, landlord, umbrella, life, commercial, motorcycle, boat, RV, and more), or when a home/auto customer would rather talk to someone later. Needs what they're interested in plus an email or phone number. Creates a follow-up task; an agent typically reaches out within one business day by phone or email. Best to confirm with the customer before sending their contact details.

interest.description: What the customer wants us to follow up about (e.g. 'renters insurance', 'life insurance', 'commercial auto')

preferred_contact_method.description: How the customer prefers to be reached: 'phone', 'email', 'text', or 'any'.

quote_id.description: Optional quote id to associate the lead with.

name: submit_lead
